SUNFLOWER.description: Produces extra sun to power your defenses. Essential in any lineup.

TWIN_SUNFLOWER.description: Generates twice the sun of a regular Sunflower in the same footprint.

SUN_SHROOM.description: A cheap mushroom that starts small and grows to produce more sun.

PRIMAL_SUNFLOWER.description: An ancient sunflower that produces larger sun more frequently.

GOLD_BLOOM.description: Expensive to plant, but pays back a huge burst of sun over time.

SUN_BEAN.description: Makes a zombie drop sun whenever it takes damage.

PEASHOOTER.description: Fires peas in a straight line. The backbone of any defensive lineup.

REPEATER.description: Fires two peas at a time for double straight-line damage.

THREEPEATER.description: Shoots peas down three lanes at once. Great for spread coverage.

SNOW_PEA.description: Frozen peas slow zombies on hit, buying your defenses time.

SPLIT_PEA.description: Fires forward and backward. Perfect against zombies that get behind you.

FIRE_PEASHOOTER.description: Flaming peas deal extra damage and thaw frozen zombies.

GOO_PEASHOOTER.description: Poison peas apply damage over time to anything they hit.

MEGA_GATLING_PEA.description: Unloads a barrage of peas. Enormous single-lane damage output.

PEA_POD.description: Stack up to five pods in one tile for escalating firepower.

MELON_PULT.description: Lobs melons over obstacles, splashing damage across nearby zombies.

WINTER_MELON.description: Lobbed melons chill and splash. Heavy damage with a slow effect.

CABBAGE_PULT.description: Lobs cabbages over shields and obstacles to hit what peas cannot.

KERNEL_PULT.description: Lobs kernels and occasionally butter, stunning a zombie in place.

CITRON.description: Charges a plasma ball that pierces through a whole line of zombies.

STARFRUIT.description: Fires stars in five directions at once. Excellent lane coverage.

BONK_CHOY.description: Punches adjacent zombies rapidly. Devastating up close.

CHOMPER.description: Swallows a zombie whole, then chews slowly while vulnerable.

CACTUS.description: Fires spikes and can extend upward to pop balloon zombies.

ROTOBAGA.description: Fires in two directions and can be planted on water.

FUME_SHROOM.description: Exhales fumes that pass through shields and hit multiple zombies.

PUFF_SHROOM.description: Free short-range mushroom. Perfect for the opening moments.

SEA_SHROOM.description: A free mushroom that can be planted directly on water.

PEPPER_PULT.description: Lobs peppers that set zombies alight on impact.

ELECTRIC_BLUEBERRY.description: Calls down lightning to strike a random zombie for heavy damage.

BOWLING_BULB.description: Rolls bulbs that ricochet between lanes, hitting many targets.

CAT_TAIL.description: Homing spikes seek out any zombie anywhere on the lawn.

PHAT_BEET.description: Slams the ground, damaging every zombie standing adjacent.

WASABI_WHIP.description: Lashes nearby zombies with spicy damage over a wide arc.

KIWIBEAST.description: Awakens into a rampaging beast that tramples an entire lane.

WALL_NUT.description: A tough nut that blocks zombies. The cornerstone of any solid defense.

TALL_NUT.description: Taller and tougher than a Wall-nut, and cannot be vaulted over.

ENDURIAN.description: A spiked defender that damages any zombie that tries to chew it.

PUMPKIN.description: Shields another plant by absorbing damage on its behalf.

GARLIC.description: Diverts zombies that bite it into an adjacent lane.

SWEET_POTATO.description: Lures zombies out of their lane and into hers.

CHERRY_BOMB.description: Detonates in a 3x3 blast, obliterating tightly packed groups.

JALAPENO.description: Incinerates every zombie in its entire lane instantly.

POTATO_MINE.description: Cheap buried mine. Needs time to arm, then destroys one zombie.

PRIMAL_POTATO_MINE.description: A larger prehistoric mine with a wider and stronger blast.

SQUASH.description: Crushes the nearest zombie regardless of how tough it is.

DOOM_SHROOM.description: Massive explosion that leaves a crater no plant can occupy.

ICE_SHROOM.description: Freezes every zombie on screen, halting the assault briefly.

EXPLODE_O_NUT.description: Blocks like a nut, then detonates when destroyed.

GRAPESHOT.description: Bursts into grapes that scatter damage across nearby tiles.

ICEBERG_LETTUCE.description: Freezes a single zombie solid the moment it makes contact.

TANGLE_KELP.description: Drags a single water zombie under and drowns it.

MAGNET_SHROOM.description: Strips metal armor, helmets, and buckets right off zombies.

TORCHWOOD.description: Ignites peas passing through it for greatly increased damage.

HOT_POTATO.description: Instantly thaws a frozen plant so it can resume fighting.

LILY_PAD.description: Provides a platform so land plants can be placed on water.

GRAVE_BUSTER.description: Consumes a gravestone, clearing the tile for planting.

HYPNO_SHROOM.description: The zombie that eats it turns and fights for your side.

CAULIPOWER.description: Hypnotizes zombies, turning them against their own horde.

IMITATER.description: Copies any other plant in your lineup for a second copy.

ENLIGHTEN_MINT.description: A powerful mint that boosts allied plants across the lawn.

APPEASE_MINT.description: Boosts appeasing plants and damages nearby zombies.

ARMA_MINT.description: Boosts armament plants with a burst of concentrated power.

BOMBARD_MINT.description: Boosts explosive plants and blasts the surrounding area.

ENFORCE_MINT.description: Boosts enforcing plants and pushes back the front line.

PIERCE_MINT.description: Boosts piercing plants and skewers zombies in a line.

REINFORCE_MINT.description: Boosts defensive plants and reinforces your barricades.

ENCHANT_MINT.description: Boosts mind-control plants and charms nearby zombies.

CAT_TAIL_MINT.description: Boosts homing plants and fires seeking spikes of its own.
